title: Sand Shards/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}
== As of February 17th, 2011 ==
* Changed to flash enchantment; increased Energy cost to 10; decreased recharge to 10 seconds; changed functionality to: "For 30 seconds, the next 1...5 times you hit with a scythe, all other adjacent foes take 10...60 earth damage."

*Functionality changed to: "For 30 seconds, Sand Shards ends early if you use an attack skill. When Sand Shards ends, it creates a sand storm at your location that deals {{gr|10|20}} damage each second for 10 seconds to nearby foes."
